training_labels: 2021 PVID snapshots (1 Jan, 31 Dec): fallow if >=70% of field on map; not fallow if <=5% on map and DWR 2021 cropped
monthly_state: first of each month, Oct-Sep water year
intensity: share of months predicted fallow, minimum 8 valid months
reference_for_test: DWR 2023: idle if >=70% of field is class I or X; cropped if >=70% is P,F,T,G,C,D,YP; others unscored
spatial_holdout: 5 folds of 3 km blocks, seed 7; each field predicted by a model that excluded its block
